data.text: Facility detection uses fixed validated rules, independent of LLM. Defaults: CO2/temperature/humidity→dashboard alert + local inspection ticket; stock→controlled replenishment proposal + alert; bin→local cleaning ticket; obstruction→alert+ticket+optional browser chime; sustained noise/tilt→alert only and disabled until calibrated/verified; telemetry loss→alert. One distance sensor has alternative placements: only stock enabled by default, bin and obstruction disabled. New CO2 physical module availability accepted from user; live integration/calibration remains hardware-owner work. No third-party messages, real spending or firmware upload in this task.
